title: 第八章 姐姐，感受一下权利吧。
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

月池不对外开放的原因是因为日月星三族魔神会在此交谈，然后在这里放松自己的心情。

听着歌舞，喝着美酒，就是他们日月星三柱魔神的生活。

如今，枫溪和白玥就体验到了他们的那份兴趣和喜悦。

枫溪拉着白玥走到三张王座的旁边。

“你这是什么意思？”

白玥愣了一下，一脸疑惑地望着枫溪。

“坐在上面，感受一下权利的力量吧。”

“权利的滋味永远是好的。”

闻言，白玥愣了一下，不可思议地望着枫溪。

她不太懂枫溪的意思。

权利的滋味？！

这话一出，真让白玥震惊了。

“姐姐，不要逃避，也不要抗拒，因为权利真的能让你变得容光焕发的。”

枫溪直接拉着白玥的手，带着她的身躯坐到那张有着逆天魔龙族魔纹的王座上。

为了让白玥的体验更好，她还让白玥的手放在两侧的扶手上。

在白玥震惊的目光下，枫溪开口道：“我的姐姐，不要抗拒这份力量。”

“你和我都是逆天魔龙族的公主，生来本就是尊贵的，无须为任何人低下自己高傲的头颅。”

枫溪顺势靠近白玥，她们俩挨得很近。

她们能闻到对方身上淡淡的香味。

枫溪很喜欢鲜艳的玫瑰花，因此她会泡玫瑰花澡。

她的身上是淡淡的玫瑰花的味道。

至于白玥，她的身上是草木的清香。因为白玥前半生过的拮据。

原因很简单，她在圣殿联盟那边是吃百家饭长大的，无父无母自然无人心疼她。

“你……”

随着枫溪的动作靠近，白玥的呼吸也凝滞起来。

整个王座很大，再加上她们身材窈窕，容纳她们俩是绰绰有余的。

白玥有些紧张，身体在颤抖着，眼角上的那抹红更多了，“不要靠我那么近……”

白玥感觉对方真的是一个流氓！

哪有妹妹这么威胁姐姐的啊！

反正白玥真的不习惯对方的靠近。

她觉得枫溪的动作太逾越了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The reason why the moon pool is not open to the public is because the demon gods of the three tribes of the sun, moon and star will talk here and relax here.

Listening to singing, dancing, and drinking wine, this is the life of their three-pillar demon god, the sun, moon, and star.

Now, Fengxi and Bai Yue have experienced their interest and joy.

Fengxi pulled Bai Yue to the side of the three thrones.

"What do you mean?"

Bai Yue was stunned for a moment and looked at Fengxi with confusion.

“Sit on it and feel the power of power.”

“Power tastes good.”

Hearing this, Bai Yue was stunned for a moment and looked at Fengxi in disbelief.

She didn't quite understand what Feng Xi meant.

What does entitlement feel like?!

When these words came out, Bai Yue was really shocked.

"Sister, don't run away or resist, because power can really make you radiant."

Fengxi directly took Bai Yue's hand and led her body to sit on the throne with the demonic pattern of the heaven-defying demonic dragon clan.

In order to make Bai Yue's experience better, she also asked Bai Yue to put his hands on the armrests on both sides.

Under Bai Yue's shocked gaze, Fengxi said: "My sister, don't resist this power."

"You and I are both princesses of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan. We are born to be noble. There is no need to lower our arrogant heads for anyone."

Fengxi took advantage of the opportunity to approach Bai Yue, and the two of them were very close.

They could smell each other's faint fragrance.

Fengxi likes bright roses very much, so she takes a rose bath.

She smelled faintly of roses.

As for Bai Yue, her body is filled with the fragrance of vegetation.Because Bai Yue lived in poverty in the first half of her life.

The reason is very simple. She grew up eating a lot of food in the Temple Alliance. She has no father and no mother. Naturally, no one cares about her.

"You..."

As Fengxi moved closer, Bai Yue's breathing became stagnant.

The entire throne is very large, and with their slim figures, it is more than enough to accommodate them both.

Bai Yue was a little nervous, her body was trembling, and the redness at the corners of her eyes became more red, "Don't get so close to me..."

Bai Yue felt that the other party was really a gangster!

How could any younger sister threaten her older sister like this?

Anyway, Bai Yue is really not used to the other party's approach.

She felt that Fengxi's actions were too transgressive.
